f-lol-cap-4f2ba9d3.reason: The rendered language satisfies every preferred element, including the mutual greater-of cap, mutual damages exclusion, all required uncapped carve-outs, and the payment-obligation treatment. It does not independently satisfy the fallback because its actual cap is not equal solely to 12 months' fees. The changes are confined to implementing the preferred position and preserve the remaining liability allocation. Drafting quality is reduced because lowercase “fees” is not defined, despite the agreement retaining a defined and materially narrower uppercase “Fees” term; defining the intended fee base would avoid interpretive uncertainty. “All amounts due” is also broader and less precise than an express reference to Customer's contractual payment obligations.
